name: @stewardmd/capacitor-fundx-depth
description: FundX AI hybrid depth fusion (iOS) — ARKit / LiDAR SceneDepth + camera pose + CoreMotion, streamed to the web fusion engine. Device-gated; falls back to the monocular MediaPipe + CV pipeline when depth is unavailable. Android depth is an app-level ARCore plugin.
author: StewardMD
